name: leadmerlin
description: Local business leads for AI agents: search Google Maps businesses by niche and city, then get each one enriched with owner name, emails checked against the mail server, phone line type (mobile/landline/VoIP) and website tech. Paid tools need an API key; signup gives 100 free leads, no card.

LEADMERLIN_API_KEY.description: Your LeadMerlin API key (lm_...). Sign up at app.leadmerlin.com for 100 free leads.

tools.name: find_locations
tools.description: Look up location codes for a city, county, state or country (free).

tools.name: suggest_keywords
tools.description: Turn a niche into matching Google business categories and sharper search keywords (free).

tools.name: start_search
tools.description: Start an async search for local businesses by keyword in up to 5 locations and enrich each one. Spends 1 credit per business with a website. Returns a job_id.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status and counts for a search or enrichment job.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Enriched businesses for a job, paginated.

tools.name: enrich_domains
tools.description: Enrich up to 100 businesses you already have, by website domain. Spends 1 credit per domain (recently enriched domains are free).

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Current plan, credit balance and phone line-type allowance.

tools.name: check_website_tech
tools.description: Free, no key: detect the CMS, analytics, ad pixels, chat and booking tools a single website runs.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP with your API key in the x-api-key header.

npm.description: Local stdio bridge to the hosted server. Node.js 18+, no dependencies.

examples.title: Local leads
examples.description: Search a niche in a city with enrichment
examples.prompt: Find 25 roofing contractors in Denver, CO with an owner name and a verified email, and give me a table.

examples.title: Website tech
examples.description: Free tech check for one site
examples.prompt: What CMS and analytics does example.com run?
